variants.subject: A faster website for {{companyName}}
variants.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I'm Jean, a local web developer based in Dubai. I came across {{companyName}} and took a look at your current website — I think it could be doing a lot more for you, so I went ahead and built a new version to show what's possible:

{{website}}

No obligation at all, I just prefer showing rather than describing. If you like the direction, happy to talk through next steps.


Best,
Jean
WhatsApp: +352621990289

Hi {{firstName}},

Just floating this back up in case it got buried. Here's the new site again:

{{website}}

I used your actual business details and real reviews — nothing generic. Let me know if you'd like any changes, or if you'd rather I just leave it as a reference.

Jean

Hi {{firstName}},

One thing I'll add — a faster, mobile-friendly site tends to directly affect how many calls and WhatsApp messages a business like {{companyName}} gets from people finding you on Google or Maps. That's really the only reason I built this for you to look at.

If it's useful, let's talk. If not, no hard feelings.

Jean

Hi {{firstName}},

I don't want to keep filling your inbox, so I'll leave it here. The link's still live if you want it later:

{{website}}

All the best to {{companyName}} either way.

Jean
WhatsApp: +352621990289
